# temps_project_internal_access (Resource)

Lets another project (or one of its environments) call this project's services over the internal network. Destroying it revokes the grant.

Import with `<project_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Let the worker project call the API project over the internal network.
resource "temps_project_internal_access" "worker_to_api" {
  project_id        = temps_project.api.id
  caller_project_id = temps_project.worker.id
  description       = "Background jobs call the API"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `caller_project_id` (Number) ID of the project allowed to call it.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project being called.

### Optional

- `caller_environment_id` (Number) Limit the grant to one environment of the caller; unset means all of them.
- `description` (String) Why the access exists.
- `target_environment_id` (Number) Limit the grant to one environment of this project; unset means all of them.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_project_internal_access.worker_to_api 8/2
```
